note: Engine settings for the device (phone, comma 3X). packs.py writes data/routing/device/valhalla.json from the build config plus these settings and the presets' requires_config. Keys are dotted paths into Valhalla's config (names checked against valhalla 3.9.1: valhalla/scripts/valhalla_build_config, src/thor/costmatrix.cc, src/loki/worker.cc). Paths in the written file are relative to the device folder; packs.engine_config() resolves them, and the app must do the same with its own files folder.

why.service_limits.auto.max_matrix_distance: CostMatrix stops each search tree at max_matrix_distance / 2 of path distance (costmatrix.cc); the default 400 km gave null cells on a 479 km trip. 1,000 km covers a state-to-state trip.
why.thor.costmatrix.allow_second_pass: the second pass (destination-only roads opened, hierarchy relaxed) removed the last 1-2 null cells
why.mjolnir.admin: admin and timezone data are baked into the tiles; the databases are builder-only
